# apple_alternative_distribution_package_version (Data Source)

Reads one version of an alternative distribution package with its variants, which are the package thinned for device types, and its deltas, which update an earlier version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_alternative_distribution_package_version" "current" {
  id = data.apple_alternative_distribution_package_versions.current.versions[0].id
}

output "variant_urls" {
  value     = data.apple_alternative_distribution_package_version.current.variants[*].url
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the package version.

### Read-Only

- `deltas` (Attributes List) The deltas of the version. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deltas))
- `file_checksum` (String) SHA-256 checksum of the package.
- `state` (String) State of the version: `COMPLETED`, `REPLACED`.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) URL the package downloads from until `url_expiration_date`.
- `url_expiration_date` (String) When `url` stops working. Read the data source again for a new URL.
- `variants` (Attributes List) The variants of the version. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variants))
- `version` (String) Version of the package.

<a id="nestedatt--deltas"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deltas`

Read-Only:

- `alternative_distribution_key_blob` (String, Sensitive) Key blob of the file, encrypted for the alternative distribution key.
- `file_checksum` (String) SHA-256 checksum of the file.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the download.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) URL the file downloads from until `url_expiration_date`.
- `url_expiration_date` (String) When `url` stops working.
